subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Failed States and Business
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Failed States and Business.

hook.text: A company operates a mine in a failed state. No functioning courts exist. When disputes arise, there's no remedy.

buildup.text: Failed states lack effective governance, rule of law, and security — creating extreme operational and legal risks.

discovery.text: The Fragile States Index ranks countries by instability. Somalia, Yemen, and South Sudan consistently top the list.

twist.text: Some firms profit in failed states by building their own infrastructure and security — becoming quasi-governments.

climax.text: Operating in failed states offers high rewards but extreme risks. Companies must build their own risk environment.

punchline.text: No courts. No security. No rules. You're on your own.

quiz.question: What is the primary business risk in failed states?
options: No functioning governance, courts, or rule of law
